# Birooni Revit Add-in Suite

> Professional Autodesk Revit Productivity & BIM Automation Tools: BiruBox & Family Loader.

## Products Overview

Birooni develops high-performance Autodesk Revit add-ins engineered for BIM modelers, architects, and structural engineers.

1. **BiruBox**: Intelligent 3D section box and view navigation suite. Eliminates manual grip dragging with 1-click isolation, interactive box drawing, and millimeter-accurate offset sizing.
2. **Family Loader**: Custom dynamic ribbon builder and instant family deployment suite. Converts `.rfa` libraries into custom ribbon tabs, panels, and stacked type buttons with automatic 3D thumbnail extraction and 1-click placement.

- **Website:** https://ibrooni.com
- **Developer / Publisher:** Birooni Tools
- **Installers:** Windows MSI (Per-User installation, no admin rights required)
- **Supported OS:** Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit)
- **Licensing API:** https://api.ibrooni.com
- **Admin Management Portal:** https://admin.ibrooni.com
- **Support Contact:** biroonisoft@gmail.com

---

## Product 1: BiruBox

- **Landing Page:** https://ibrooni.com
- **Direct Download:** https://ibrooni.com/downloads/BiruBox-Setup.msi
- **Current Version:** 2026.1.0
- **Supported Revit Versions:** Autodesk Revit 2025, Autodesk Revit 2026, Autodesk Revit 2027 (.NET 8.0)

### BiruBox Core Tools
- **AutoSectionBox**: Intelligent bounding box generation around selected model elements, rooms, or entire systems.
- **DrawBox**: Freehand 3D bounding box drawing directly in plan views or 3D views to isolate specific project areas.
- **Quick AutoSection**: One-click immediate 3D section box around the active Revit selection.
- **Grow Bounds**: Expand section box margins dynamically (+100mm, +500mm, etc.) with ribbon controls or custom hotkeys.
- **Shrink Bounds**: Contract section box margins dynamically to tighten view boundaries without losing orientation.
- **Toggle State**: Instantly toggle section box visibility and active clipping on/off without opening Revit View Properties.

---

## Product 2: Family Loader

- **Landing Page:** https://ibrooni.com/family-loader.html
- **Direct Download:** https://ibrooni.com/downloads/FamilyLoader-Setup.msi
- **Current Version:** 2026.1.0
- **Supported Revit Versions:** Autodesk Revit 2020 through 2027 (.NET 8.0 & .NET Framework 4.8)

### Family Loader Core Tools
- **Dynamic Ribbon Builder**: Construct custom Revit ribbon tabs and panels directly mapped to office `.rfa` family libraries.
- **1-Click Interactive Placement**: Click any ribbon family button to load and activate placement in the current Revit view immediately.
- **Automatic 3D Thumbnail Extraction**: Binary extraction of authentic Revit 3D preview thumbnails from `.rfa` headers, or custom icon assignment.
- **Types as Push Button**: Expose individual family types directly on ribbon panels with 1, 2, or 3-row vertical stacking.
- **Visual Ribbon Studio**: Drag-and-drop tab, panel, and family reordering with real-time configuration preview.
- **Team Import / Export**: Standardize office libraries with single-file JSON configuration export and deployment.
- **Permanent Revit Trust**: Immutable bootstrapper (`FamilyLoader.Loader.dll`) prevents "Publisher could not be verified" dialogs on updates.

---

## Architecture & Security
- **Startup:** Non-blocking asynchronous licensing cache. Revit launches in milliseconds without UI freezing.
- **Offline Support:** Cryptographically signed RSA-2048 SHA-256 node-locked licenses tied to hardware fingerprints (Motherboard, CPU, Machine GUID). Works 100% offline with 14-day token cache (`%ProgramData%\Birooni\familyloader.lic` and `license.lic`).
- **Automated Updates:** Built-in background update engine checks for new builds via https://api.ibrooni.com, downloads ZIP packages, stages files, and updates automatically on Revit exit.

## Licensing & Pricing (Per Product)
- **14-Day Free Trial:** $0 (Full access to all features, instant automated hardware activation, no credit card required).
- **Perpetual Pro:** $149 one-time (Lifetime usage, node-locked, 1-year free updates included, offline capable).
- **Enterprise / Floating:** $299 / seat / year (Concurrent network license pool, central admin portal, priority SLA).
